modules.name: SaaS Subscription & Billing
modules.description: Mesin langganan NADI Billing sendiri untuk operator ISP (tenant) berlangganan platform ini.

features.name: Manajemen Plan & Harga
features.description: Plan bertingkat dengan harga per siklus billing dan batasan per plan.
features.businessBenefit: Fleksibilitas penawaran paket sesuai skala operator.
features.marketingMessage: Pilih paket sesuai kebutuhan bisnis Anda.

features.name: Manajemen Organisasi (Tenant)

features.marketingMessage: Undang tim Anda, kelola akses bersama.

features.name: Siklus Hidup Langganan

features.name: Kode Voucher/Promo SaaS

features.name: Invoice, Pajak & Pembayaran Manual
features.description: Invoice otomatis dengan pajak, upload bukti transfer, approval admin.
features.businessBenefit: Proses pembayaran sesuai kebiasaan transfer bank lokal.

features.name: Grace Period & Dunning

features.businessBenefit: Mengurangi churn akibat lupa bayar.

features.name: Portal Billing Self-Service

features.name: Referral/Affiliate
